Hi Candlespice Co. team,

I liked the City Lights candles with the Cincinnati skyline on the label, and saw your Signature candles come in 4 oz, 8 oz and 16 oz across a lot of scents. Would scent-by-size alerts be useful for your next pour?

Best regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
Shopify Automation & Integration Specialist
